defense_news.title: German government blames Russia for Leipzig airport drone attack with explosives
defense_news.summary: Russia was behind the failed explosive drone attack on Germany’s key Leipzig/Halle Airport last month, the authorities in Berlin have concluded.

defense_news.title: How a middling Chinese guided-missile frigate unnerves Japan, Taiwan and the US
defense_news.summary: China’s navy has introduced a new guided-missile frigate designed for coastal as well as open-sea attacks.

defense_news.title: After 286 days at sea, USS Abraham Lincoln arrives in Thailand
defense_news.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln arrived in Thailand on Wednesday morning after more than 200 days at sea.

defense_news.title: Ousted Ukrainian defense chief lands Palantir CEO as first investor in new venture
defense_news.summary: Ukraine’s recently ousted defense minister Mykhailo Fedorov is teaming up with Palantir CEO Alex Karp to launch a new defense company.
